subject: general
question: Who among the following Indian women was named by TIME magazine as one of the 100 powerful women who defined the last century?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Amrit Kaur**__.

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• TIME magazine named** Kaur as 'Women of the Year for 1947 **and **Indira Gandhi for 1976 in special covers recreated by the publication.**
 
• She earlier** joined the Indian National Congress**, becoming a working member of the freedom struggle while as well **focusing on social reform.**
 
• She actively worked against the **devadasi system** and the practice of **child marriage.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/13ddb1f5a4d3056fb9ef5c8a041df78613bc5f8deaa7fd2ef2c2a48456680755.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kasturbai Mohandas Gandhi** was an Indian political campaigner. 
 
• **Sucheta Kripalani **was an Indian freedom fighter and minister. 
 
• **Sarojini Naidu** was an Indian political campaigner, feminist, and poet. ​
